description: Predicted Building Damage: Venezuela Earthquakes (Catia La Mar, La Guaira, and Caraballeda) 2026 is a dataset listed in Microsoft Planetary Computer data catalogue, a cloud catalogue of environmental and geospatial data sets, published or maintained by Microsoft AI for Good Lab. Following the June 2026 earthquakes that struck the central coast of Venezuela, the Microsoft AI for Good Lab ran their building damage assessment AI models to map and classify the buildings affected by the earthquakes. Coverage: buildings of Catia La Mar, La Guaira and Caraballeda after the June 2026 earthquakes. The catalogue entry lists assets named data, reachable through the STAC API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure exposure, hazard and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-planetary-computer-catalogue.
